full_judgment: 2. The pre-emptee-petitioner received the case land from his aunt respondent No. 3, Moyna Sundari by way of gift by a registered document dated 2.10.80. The pre-emptor-respondent Nos. 1 and 2 filed Miscellaneous Case No. 17 of 1981 in the court of the Assistant Judge, Manikgonj for pre-emption of the case land. The case was transferred to the court of Assistant Judge, Daulatpur Upazila and re-numbered as Miscellaneous Case No. 21 1984. Their case was that the pre-emptee-petitioner was not a co-sharer in the case holding and the deed of gift was a pre-emptible, one. Among other defences the pre-emptee-petitioner contended that the miscellaneous case was bad for non-joinder of parties and that the deed of gift is not a pre-emptible document.
